Third-party libraries served from the site itself (no CDN dependency). Pinned versions; the
integrity hashes in index.html are the official sha384 of each file.
  maplibre-gl 4.7.1 (BSD-3-Clause)   maplibre-gl.js, maplibre-gl.css
  h3-js 4.1.0 (Apache-2.0)           h3-js.umd.js
  deck.gl 9.0.38 (MIT)               deck.gl.min.js
To upgrade: download the new file here and update its integrity hash in index.html.
